title: What a push made and the customer then deleted for good on live goes from the copy, meta and links included
steps: Run the live-sync-pushed case for #223 (real MariaDB, WordPress tables): the settle sync after a push of a page with meta, two menu items, a template part, Additional CSS and a picture; then the live site deletes them for good and the next sync runs.
expect: Settle sync: nothing kept or held, 7 posts, the copy page holds the live guid, the custom link object id is the copy number. After the delete: nothing kept, only the sample page left, no postmeta, no term relationships.
evidence: Issue #223 re-test: WordPress 6.8 kept db:wp_posts:["9"] and ["10"] as delete-modify; only guid differed

tests: WordPress: what a push made and the customer then deleted for good on the live site goes from the copy too
